query: Consider JBF's Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document indicate that the Agreement does not grant the Receiving Party any rights to the Confidential Information?
gold: 8. All right, title and interest in and to the Confidential Information, including, without limitation, all patent rights, trade secret and confidential information rights, copyrights and other intellectual property, industrial, proprietary and other rights of any kind or nature, shall remain the exclusive property of the Disclosing Party, and the Confidential Information shall be held in trust and confidence by the Receiving Party for the Disclosing Party. The Disclosing Party shall retain title to all tangible media on which Confidential Information resides, including documentation, discs, and all copies thereof. No interest, license or any other right in, or to, the Confidential Information, other than expressly set out herein, is granted to the Receiving Party under this Agreement by implication or otherwise.
rag_answer:
Yes. The JBF Non-Disclosure Agreement expressly states that all right, title, and interest in the Confidential Information remain the exclusive property of the Disclosing Party, and that:

> “No interest, license or any other right in, or to, the Confidential Information, other than expressly set out herein, is granted to the Receiving Party under this Agreement by implication or otherwise.”

This means the Agreement does not grant the Receiving Party any rights to the Confidential Information beyond what is expressly provided in the Agreement.

judge.gold_summary: 金标规定保密信息的所有权利、所有权和利益仍归披露方所有；除协议明确授予外，不通过默示或其他方式向接收方授予对保密信息的任何权益、许可或其他权利。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答确认协议不授予接收方任何超出明确规定的保密信息权利，并引用了‘No interest, license or any other right... other than expressly set out herein, is granted to the Receiving Party...’这一关键内容。
judge.reason: 系统回答覆盖了金标的关键结论，即除协议明确授予外，接收方不因默示或其他方式获得对保密信息的权利，因此判定命中。
